purpose: Catalogue of NBA awards and honors across eras, with each award's first season, electorate, scoring rule and the dated rule changes that gate how a season's vote may be run.
location_note: An era-spanning reference kept in library/2003/league, like 00_Team/Finances/league_cap_history.json, because the 2003 cycle is where the career starts; it is world knowledge about how the league decides honors, not a result of any season.
era_gating: An award may be voted in a season only if its first_season is on or before that season and its last_season is null or on or after it. A rule in `rules` applies only from its first_season; a later rule never applies retroactively (the 65-game rule of 2023-24 never touches the 2003-04 vote). `runtime/award_records.awards_in_force(season)` reads this file; docs/awards_catalog.md explains it.

status_values.sourced: stated by a fetched page listed in `sources`
status_values.derived: computed from figures on a fetched page (for example ballots from a maximum point total); the derivation is in the note
status_values.unverified: not established by any fetched page; never a basis for a simulated vote until researched

hindsight_note: Sources were read for rules and dates only. Real winners, vote totals and results after June 26, 2003 are not catalogued and must not be imported.
season_format: YYYY-YY; a season is compared by its starting year
honor_name_contract: The `honor_names` an award writes to awards.json must match runtime/standing.py HONOR_* names where one exists: All-Star, All-NBA First/Second/Third Team, Most Valuable Player, Finals MVP.

regular_season.definition: The club's regular-season games of the season; voting closes after the last regular-season game and winners are announced during the playoffs.

announcement.value: during the playoffs; in 2004 the Rookie of the Year was announced April 20 and the All-Rookie teams April 27
announcement.note: the fetched pages show only the dated headlines; the other 2004 announcement dates are unverified

award_week.definition: An official Monday-to-Sunday window announced by the league; it can cross this repository's fixed day 1-7, 8-14, 15-21, 22-end buckets, and the honor is filed on the week page containing the period's end date.

announcement.note: the official example announcement names the period and the other nominees; a Monday announcement is the usual practice, not a fetched rule

calendar_month.definition: The calendar month's games; October and April are partial months.

announcement.value: early in the following month, before the player's next home game for Rookie of the Month

all_star_break.definition: Selection announced before the All-Star Game: starters first, reserves later.

all_star_weekend.definition: The Rookie Challenge / Rising Stars game on All-Star weekend (2004: Friday, February 13).

nba_cup.definition: Group play, knockout rounds and the championship game of the in-season tournament, from 2023-24.

rules.name: 65-game eligibility rule
rules.text: A player must appear in at least 65 games, counting only games with at least 20 minutes played, plus up to two near misses of 15 to 19 minutes; 62 credited games suffice after a season-ending injury. Rookie of the Year, Sixth Man of the Year and All-Rookie are not covered. Clutch Player coverage is not stated by the fetched pages.
rules.note: A later rule: the 2003-04 vote must not use it.

rules.name: MVP voted by media
rules.text: Players voted the MVP through 1979-80; sportswriters and broadcasters from 1980-81.

rules.name: One fan ballot in the MVP vote
rules.text: 'Starting from 2010, one ballot was cast by fans through online voting.' The season boundary is inferred from the year; unverified as a season.

rules.name: All-NBA positionless
rules.text: No positional slots from 2023-24; two guards, two forwards and one center before.

rules.name: All-Defensive voted by media
rules.text: Head coaches voted through 2012-13; a panel of writers and broadcasters from 2013-14.

rules.name: All-Rookie Second Team
rules.text: Wikipedia's table shows a second team from 1989-90; the exact first season of the second team is not stated in prose.

rules.name: Executive of the Year voted by club executives
rules.text: The Sporting News selected the award through 2008; club executives vote from 2009. The season boundary is inferred from the year.

rules.name: All-Star frontcourt ballot
rules.text: 'Prior to 2013, fans selected two forwards and one center instead of generic frontcourt players.'

rules.name: All-Star weighted starter vote
rules.text: From the 2017 game, starters by fans 50%, players 25%, media 25%.

rules.name: All-Star captains' draft
rules.text: From the 2018 game, the top vote-getters of each conference draft the teams regardless of conference.

rules.name: Statistical titles on per-game averages
rules.text: Totals decided the scoring, rebounding and assists titles through 1968-69; per-game averages from 1969-70.

rules.name: 58-game qualification for rate titles
rules.text: 58 games (70% of 82) or a total that would still lead when divided by 58; 82 made threes for the three-point title. In 2003-04 the thresholds were 70 games or the total minimums listed on each title.
